import json,sys,time,resource,os,hashlib,struct
from pathlib import Path
from byteforge.query import QuerySession
from byteforge.word_index import IndexedQuerySession
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{min(os.sched_getaffinity(0))})
start=time.perf_counter_ns()
options={'worker':Path('build/btrblocks-bytefast-release/byteforge_integer_worker'),'cache_bytes':0}
cls=QuerySession
if len(sys.argv)>2:
 cls=IndexedQuerySession; options['word_index']=Path(sys.argv[2])
with cls(Path(sys.argv[1]),**options) as s: result=s.filter('contains','warning')
query_ns=time.perf_counter_ns()-start
sha=hashlib.sha256(b''.join(struct.pack('<Q',v) for v in result['row_ids'])).hexdigest()
r=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF)
print(json.dumps({'query_ns':query_ns,'user_cpu_s':r.ru_utime,'system_cpu_s':r.ru_stime,'peak_rss_bytes':r.ru_maxrss*1024,'result_sha256':sha,'count':result['count']}))
